name: Zealous Faith
body:
Your devotion to your faith is powerful.

Prerequisite: Blessing, Dogma, Domain, or Inquisition

Benefit: Treat your effective warpriest (blessing), priest (dogma), cleric (domain), or inquisitor (inquisition) level as one level higher for the corresponding powers. This does not grant you early access to abilities. In addition, you may prepare your dogma/domain spells in your regular spell slots.
